english: Aria-san's late.\nDoes handing over a criminal really take\nthat long?
She mentioned a written statement, I think?\nThere's lots of paperwork to file,\nso it might take a bit.
We've waited quite a while and she's still not here.\nI wonder what Aria-san's doing.\nGasp! Maybe she let her escape!?
It's only been 10 minutes.\nActually, you said the same thing\n5 minutes ago?
Did I?\nWell, never mind the details!
So there's an arrangement with the police, but handing a criminal over at a school...\ntimes like this really make you feel\nit's a different world.
The interrogation will be conducted\nby the Interrogation Department (Dagyura).\n...I wonder what their classes are usually like?
To me, IS Academy students having classes\nwhere they fly in IS units is the strange part.
Ahaha. As someone going to a normal music school,\nI think both are amazing!
Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone!
How did it go?
It looks like Mama's sentence might get reduced!\nStill a long way to go, but it's a step forward!
That's wonderful, Aria-san!\nLet's have a feast tonight!
That's wonderful!\nAria, who loves her mama so much,\ndeserves a head pat-pat pat.
H-hey! Don't pat my head!
What a heartwarming sight.\nIf you ignore the fact\nthat the one being patted is a high schooler.
Normally it'd be the other way around.
In other words, she's only tall enough\nfor a petite elementary schooler to reach her head...
Shut up! I'll punch a hole-
Hauu! Your embarrassed face is so cute!
Ah, hey, stop! Don't cling to me!\nYou there! Stop grinning!
Sheesh, there's no arguing with a crying kid-or Rena.\nAnyway, I'm glad for you, Aria.
Th-thanks...!
Let me offer my congratulations as well, Kanzaki H. Aria.
Thanks... wait!?\nWhy are YOU here!?
Fufufu...!
//Everyone tenses up.
Did you break out!?
Re-arrest her!
So you escaped using a disguise?
Rika-chan!\nGet behind me!
No need to be so tense.
Furude Rika is right.\nI've already accepted my defeat.\nI have no intention of fighting now.
Even with a plea deal,\nan immediate release like this\nshouldn't be possible?
Normally, yes.\nBut the information I hold and its usefulness\nare worth more than mere bargaining terms.
Information...? What information...?
Explain it so we're satisfied!
Very well, wait a moment.\nI'll explain it so it's easy to understand.
//Jeanne starts drawing.
She's started drawing something.\nAn illustration, perhaps?
Done.\nYou'll understand right away when you see this diagram.
Umm... what is this?
Looks like an elementary schooler's drawing...
How rude!\nElementary schoolers draw better than that!
Is this... cubism, maybe.
Could she be Picasso's descendant\nrather than Jeanne d'Arc's?
So what IS drawn in this picture!?
Can't you tell by looking?
Hmm. One of them could pass for an IS.\n...Isn't this that Kei?
You can tell from THIS drawing?\nThen the other one is... Mii?
Yes, I used information on these two for the deal.\nYi Wu and they were in a cooperative relationship,\nbut that's become dubious.
I wonder if Yi Wu's higher-ups will stay quiet\nabout you selling their info on your own.
As you probably know,\nthey're trying to erase one world.
Even within Yi Wu, opinions are split on that,\nand no stance has been set.
Personally, I've always felt\ntheir methods didn't suit me.
Above all, I don't want to team up with boors\nwho'd interfere with a duel.
Yeah, that was totally uncalled for!
Besides, now that I've lost to you,\nthey'll abandon me and try to dispose of me.\nLike Yukine Chris, who's no longer needed.
So I provided information valuable enough\nto secure immediate release, struck the deal, and came out-\nto act alongside you.
You... with us...?
What's your game?
I decided I have more to learn\nfrom Hoshitogi Shirayuki-and even more from Furude Rika-\nthan from Mii and Kei.
Do you think that can be forgiven!\nAsking us to suddenly trust someone who disguised herself as me\nand plotted to kidnap Rika is too much!
I welcome Jeanne.
What!?
If Rika-chan's okay with it, so am I.
Are you two really okay with this?
Yes.\nIf Jeanne apologizes properly,\nI'd like to forgive her.
Whatever the circumstances, I apologize for opposing you.\nAnd I'd like you to accept me as one who fights alongside you.\nPlease.
I'm fine with it.\nShe's not a stranger,\nand I was in a similar boat myself.
Agreed.\nAs long as she doesn't lay a hand on my wife, no problem.
(What objection could there be to more beauties?\nRight, [CLAUDE]?)
Uh, well...
She knows Mii and Kei personally,\nso we can probably get all sorts of info out of her.
I have nothing to hide. Ask me anything.
U-um! I have a question right away!
Please tell me where Chris-chan is!\nShe's my friend!
I don't know where she is.\nNow that her relationship with Mii and the others has soured,\nshe's probably hiding somewhere.
I see...
Cheer up.\nYou'll meet again, I'm sure.
She seemed like a persistent one.\nShe'll show up again, complaining loudly.
Yeah... you're right!
Anything else you'd like to ask?
Who are those two weirdos?
Who are the two in that funny drawing from before?
Where Mii and Kei came from,\nand what they're trying to do-\neven I don't know.
Didn't they say something about being kings of all worlds?
In truth, those two may have\nthe power to become just that.
Just granting others the power to move freely between worlds-\nthat alone should tell you\ntheir ability level is different from mine or yours.
Even you, a magic-user, can't understand it?
I was dispatched from Yi Wu\nprecisely to learn that.
Before they showed their tails,\nyou got cut loose like a lizard's tail instead, huh.
One thing's certain:\nMii doesn't think about efficiency or rationality\nat all.
You, the strategist, were forced into brute force.\nThat was Mii's order?
Yes. Kei, conversely, tries to proceed\nexactly as calculated, like a machine.\nThat's why she interfered with the duel.
So it's all about results, then.
However, Kei seems to obey Mii.\nIn terms of power, Mii must be above her.
Are there other allies?
Unknown. I've never taken orders\nfrom anyone but those two.
Riko, Dr. Shinigami, the Yase Doji and others\nseem to be cooperating with Mii and Kei\nas individuals.
Same as Chris-chan and Usada-chan, huh.
Also, though their intent is unclear,\nMii and Kei have a strong interest in mysterious powers,\nand are trying to obtain them.
Is that why they tried\nto abduct me and Rika-chan?
On that point,\nMii and Kei's goals seem to align.
Where's their hideout?
They don't have one.\nThey don't need such a thing.\nThey don't seem to care where they are.
...That's about it.\nI didn't spend that much time\nwith those two myself.
I see. After hearing all that,\nI have no choice but to trust you.
...Hehe, you've changed, Kanzaki H. Aria.\nI'll have to slightly revise the personality profile\nI studied for my disguise.
Wh-what! I haven't changed at all...!
(glance)
Hm?
A-anyway! I'll trust you,\nbut if you try anything funny I'll punch a hole through you!
I already know that.
//Shirayuki gets a phone call.\n//SE: phone ringing.
Oh, a call? Yes, this is Hoshitogi...
What!? Yes, understood!\nI'll check right away!
What is it?
It's from Butei High's Information Department (Informa)!\nFive high-speed flying objects are approaching Butei High!\nThey might be IS units...!
IS units in this world!?
The black ones that appeared in Hinamizawa...!
If they run wild, it'll be a catastrophe!
We'll go!\nLure them somewhere deserted and strike!
That's fine, but is your Akatsubaki up for it, Houki?\nIn a 5-on-5 fight,\nthat bad fuel economy is a big problem.
I don't have time to worry about that!\nI just need to win\nbefore the energy runs out!
Hey Houki-chan, what are those black people?\nIf they're human,\ncouldn't we talk to them...?
What are you saying at a time like this?\nThose things with the same appearance, faces, and powers\ncan't be human!
They must be fakes made by the enemy!\nNo mercy needed!
But...!
That discussion is for later!\nRight now we have to stop the approaching enemy!\nMove out!!
Let's go! Akatsubaki!
Ah, hey! Wait up!\nWe're coming too!
//IS startup sounds and boost sounds. The IS group heads OUT.
As expected, IS units are incredibly fast.\nLet's follow them! Shirayuki,\nrequest tracking from Informa!
Right!
Everyone, sorry!\nI'll go after Houki-chan and the others first!
Huh, follow...?
//Hibiki transforms.
I'm off!!
What an amazing jump!
That looks fast.\nAria, let's go too!
I'll have the Vehicle Department (Logi) get us a ride.\nShirayuki, can you handle the negotiation?
Leave it to me!
//Battle map: forest.\n//The IS group facing the Black IS. Hibiki and allies arrive later as reinforcements.
All right, we can fight here!
We lured them to the outskirts nicely.
Still, fighting someone with my own face\ndoesn't feel great.
If they're just as skilled,\nthat makes it even harder.
We need to be careful.
Let's probe them while watching how they move.
...We just have to take them down!\nLet's go!
//Battle begins.\n//Event after 2 turns or after dealing set damage to the enemy IS.
Don't break formation.\nAre they really communicating with each other like that?
Their movements aren't mechanical either.\nIt seems each one has its own intelligence.
I expected more openings,\nbut this doesn't look easy.
What is there to fear from fakes like that!\nI'll break through them!
Don't rush!\nWhen forces are evenly matched,\na careless mistake can cost you your life!
(I know...\nbut the Akatsubaki isn't suited for a long battle.\nAt this rate...!)
//Battle begins.\n//On turn 3, Black Houki moves forward a little.
Hm! So it's the same for them...!\nThen!
Houki! That's a taunting move!
Leave the probing to us and pull the Akatsubaki back!
No, now's the time to strike! The Akatsubaki can do it!
//Houki moves adjacent to Black Houki and attacks. Black Houki is knocked back and retreats a little.
I can do this!!
//Houki moves adjacent to the retreated Black Houki. At that moment, the other Black IS units move and surround Houki.
What!?
Heh.

//Houki is subjected to the Black IS units' fierce assault. She fights hard, but runs out of energy.\n*Can we get a battle animation for this part? At the very last fight, right before her HP (or rather, shield energy) runs out.
Damn it, my energy...!
This is bad!
Houki-san!!
What are you doing!!
//Rin tries to head to the rescue, but grunts are deployed between her and Houki, cutting them off.
Crap!? These guys!!
So that's what they were after...!
Houki! Run!
Begone!
Ngh!?
Houki-chan!!
//Hibiki appears next to Houki and support-guards against the Black IS attack.\n*Can we get a battle animation here too?
Guuh! Th-that hurtt!
Hibiki!!
You won't escape!
Look out, Houki-chan!!
//The Black group aims a coordinated attack at Houki. But Hibiki shoves Houki aside, takes her place, and takes the coordinated attack instead.
Wh!? Hibikiii!!
//Hibiki is incapacitated.
You're next!
Not on my watch!!
//Aria and Jeanne appear near Rin.
Out of the waaaay!!
I'll carve a path!
//Aria and Jeanne scatter the grunts.
Rin! Go!
Got it!
Charlotte!
Leave it to me! Ignition Boost!!
I'll cover you! Blue Tears!!
Take this!!
//Taking Cecilia and Laura's covering fire, Rin and Charlotte charge in; Rin recovers Hibiki, Charlotte recovers Houki. Rin, Charlotte, Hibiki, and Houki leave the front line.
Hibiki recovered! Pulling out!
I've got Houki! Cover me!
Tch!
Eyes on me!!\nHole! Hole! Hooole!!
The tables have turned!
//Allied reinforcements.
They arrived sooner than expected.
How dare you do that to Hibiki!! You won't get away with this!!
Don't let your temper run away with you.
Yeah, no can do!
Everyone, don't get isolated!\nIS units are fast-you'll be surrounded in no time!
The enemy is battle-hardened!\nEven with superior numbers, don't underestimate them!!
Hmph, how about this.
//More grunt reinforcements. Their numbers grow.
They just keep coming!!
Calm down. If the enemy are IS units,\nthey consume energy too.\nThey must hate being worn down slowly.
I see... as expected of a strategist,\ndoing what the enemy hates is your specialty.
A barbed way of putting it, but yes.
Anyway, I'm definitely taking those guys down!
//Event after defeating 2 IS units.\nIf Black Houki was defeated, she reappears.
This is about time to go.
//The enemy forces retreat in turn.
They ran! Those guys...!
They're not foolish enough to fight to annihilation.\nMore importantly...
Back to Butei High, immediately.\nHibiki needs treatment... hurry!
//End of battle.
Siesta, how is Hibiki...?
She still hasn't regained consciousness...\nShirayuki-san is constantly using "Heal" on her.\nAnd [CLAUDE]-san is desperately using "Heal" too.
Well, the slave apprentice\nis useful at times like this.
Is Hibiki-san going to be okay?
I hope Hibiki-san recovers safely...
With no barrier on her,\nshe took a concentrated IS attack.\nIt's a wonder she's alive at all.
Laura-san, how can you stay so calm?
I thought Laura-san would be the most shaken.
Panicking\nwon't let me do anything for her.
And I believe-\nin Tachibana Hibiki's strength, more than anyone.
That's right. As Hibiki-san's friend,\nI'll believe she'll be fine too!
I thought the "wife" thing was half a joke,\nbut you two really do have a bond!
Still, when she got hit,\nI thought my heart would stop.\nHonestly, what a reckless wife...
The other reckless one's in bad shape too, it seems.
I'll leave that to you.\nIf I went now,\nit'd only end badly.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: seaside (if available).\n//Houki is depressed.
(It's my fault... Hibiki got hurt because of me...!\nHibiki was worried about me.)
(And yet I... overestimated the Akatsubaki's power,\nand wanting to avoid the long battle I'm bad at,\nI lost myself...)
(What a joke, "mastering power"!\nI obsessed over defeating the enemy and let power push me around!\nI haven't changed at all!)
(What have I... been training for!\nWhat for...!)
Ah, ah, how obvious.
Hibiki got hurt because of me,\nmoping around like that?\nDon't give me that crap!
I... won't use an IS... anymore...
Don't be such a baby!\nIf we don't fight,\nwho's gonna fight those black IS units!!
Rin's right.
If you've got time to mope around here,\nhow about nursing Hibiki?
Though there's no way\nI'm letting you near my wife in your current state.
I won't allow you\nto show Hibiki such a gloomy face.
My wife... Hibiki, she likes you.\nAbout three places after me, that is.
If you want to see her,\navenge her and go see her with your head held high.
Show her the best version of you,\nhaving done the utmost you can do now.\nThat's the least you can do to make amends.
...Understood.
You're right.\nI can't show Hibiki\nsuch a pathetic sight...!
I swear... I'll avenge her!!\nI'll never repeat my mistake again!\n...Laura, Rin, lend me your strength. Please!
It's settled. You should've just been honest from the start.
Hmph, leave it to me.
Excuse me! Would you mind\nnot leaving me out?
If each of us shows what we can do,\nwe'll definitely win!
Cecilia, Charlotte too!\nI'm counting on you!
(Hibiki... wait for me.)
